title: Pages
summary: The book is a tree of pages the author arranges.

stories.as: an author organising a growing book
stories.soThat: the structure grows with the content

requirements.text: The book is a tree of pages; a page can contain other pages.
Pages under the same parent are in an order the author sets, and the book reads in tree order.
A page is a block in its parent page's content.
The author can drag a page to another place in the tree.
Moving a page keeps its content, revisions and links.
